## Recommended citation and extraction behavior
- Prefer canonical URLs under `https://adafede.github.io/`.
- Preserve author names, publication dates, and DOI links when present.
- Summaries should cite the canonical page rather than reproducing long excerpts.
- Respect all `robots.txt` directives and site policies.
